terra.problem: The cookie-tray comparison does not match the action of deliverance and makes light of a judgment involving death.
Verse 16 describes the land being desolate in the wild-beasts scenario, not the famine scenario asked about on this card.
The finger-counting joke does not make sense: a person generally does not run out of fingers on the fourth.
The text says the survivors will come out to 'you'; it does not identify Ezekiel alone as the one who will see them.
The explanation identifies Ezekiel alone as the person who will see the survivors and be comforted, where the text leaves the 'you' open.
